request.subject: The Titanic Stewardess Who Wouldn't Sink - part 2: A Stranger's Baby in Lifeboat 16
request.title: The Titanic Stewardess Who Wouldn't Sink (Part 2/3)
request.description:
On Titanic's last night, an officer handed Violet Jessop a baby, and on the rescue ship a stranger took it and ran. Who do you think that woman was?

Part 2 of 3: The Titanic Stewardess Who Wouldn't Sink

Sources:
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Violet_Jessop
https://www.nationalgeographic.com/magazine/article/titanic-woman-survivor-nurse-illness-unsinkable
https://www.history.co.uk/articles/unsinkable-violet-jessop

Stock footage: Pexels. Made with AI-assisted narration.

#shorts #truestory

extra_params.video_script: The officer handed Violet a baby. In Part 1, Violet joined Titanic after its sister ship Olympic crashed into a warship. After the iceberg, she was ordered on deck to set an example for non-English speakers. Then, according to her memoir, an officer gave her a baby to look after. She carried it into Lifeboat 16. On the rescue ship Carpathia, a woman snatched the baby and ran off without a word. Nobody knows what became of that child. Four years later, Violet's lifeboat was dragged toward a sinking ship's propellers. Subscribe so you don't miss Part 3.
